{{Youmay|the [[Vergesso Base]] [[Cantina/Legends|bar]]|[[Hangar/Legends|hangars]], also known as docking bays}}
The '''Docking Bay''' was a smoky dive [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] on [[The Life]] level of the [[Vergesso Base]] [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]]. It was owned by a [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] named [[Phrusaani]].

It was constantly busy since it opened along with the Base. A rather quiet place, its [[Holo-player/Legends|holo-player]] played mainly [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes/Legends|Modal Nodes]] and [[smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], [[merchant/Legends|traders]] preferred its curtained booths to make their deals, far from the landlord's interest. [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] players gathered in the back room; one long game started 3 days after the base opened, went through the [[Galactic Civil War]] until the [[Battle of the Bajic Shipyards|its destruction]].
